patch.value: Align pm-presets with pm 2026.8.7 and harden merge-driver lifecycle

Adopt the current pm CLI/SDK and pm-changelog, install the canonical generated-extension merge fence, replace the authored JavaScript lifecycle helper with erasable TypeScript, and prove POSIX and real Windows command resolution without conflating this bounded compatibility tranche with full release readiness.

The lockfile resolves @unbrained/pm-cli and pm-changelog 2026.8.7 and the peer floor is 2026.8.7; pm merge install emits extensions/** -merge and scopes pm-json to .managed-extensions.json; lifecycle source is erasable TypeScript with no dynamic imports and resolves target-platform PATH/PATHEXT safely; npm ci runs the real prepare hook on windows-latest with a real cmd shim under a spaced and percent-delimited path; lifecycle tests reach exact 100/100/100; npm and Bun package gates plus fresh packed-artifact installed-pm acceptance pass; privacy/history and full-source quality limits are tracked independently; exact-head bot review is dispositioned before merge
Canonical main is clean and unique, no open package item or PR duplicates this tranche, installed and registry pm are 2026.8.7, and the baseline release gate is measured honestly.
Concurrent agents get deterministic PM extension-asset merge semantics from installs on supported platforms.
Prevents generated extension assets from entering semantic field merges and makes lifecycle failures observable on Windows.

message: Start bounded pm 2026.8.7 compatibility and lifecycle hardening tranche
